def factor_attentive_sales_yield_winsor(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    sales_yield = 1.0 / df_copy["ps_ttm"].replace(0, np.nan)
    inattention = 1.0 - df_copy["free_turn"].rolling(20, min_periods=1).rank(pct=True)
    sales_yield = sales_yield.ffill()
    inattention = inattention.ffill()
    raw = sales_yield * inattention
    lower = raw.rolling(60, min_periods=20).quantile(0.05)
    upper = raw.rolling(60, min_periods=20).quantile(0.95)
    winsorized = raw.clip(lower=lower, upper=upper)
    df_copy["factor_attentive_sales_yield_winsor"] = winsorized
    return df_copy["factor_attentive_sales_yield_winsor"]
